purpose: Tell a local Cursor host where TripCoreX / MinnDrive apps live so a TestFlight build can continue.

claimedProductLayout.source: marketing copy in this repo, not verified source trees

cloudAgentSearch.conclusion: Driver and rider source is not in this cloud workspace. It is either on the Mac locally, in a private GitHub repo this token cannot see, or only in Expo/EAS / App Store Connect.

localHostNextSteps: Do not open dhakgilim/TripCoreX for the TestFlight IPA. That folder is the tripcorex.com marketing site.
On the Mac, search for Expo/Xcode projects: app.json, app.config.ts, eas.json, *.xcworkspace, android/, ios/.
Likely local folder names: MinnDrive, minndrive, MinnDrive-admin, minndrive-admin, rider, driver.
If the apps are private GitHub repos, open those repos in local Cursor (this cloud token only scopes TripCoreX).
Continue TestFlight from the Expo Rider and/or Kotlin/iOS Driver project on a Mac with Xcode, not from this site.
